name: sofa-arcade-desktop
description: Tauri Mac packaging and native validation for the existing Sofa Arcade LAN runtime

scripts.build:mac:arm64: node scripts/prepare.mjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin && node scripts/licenses.mjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --ci --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg -- --locked
scripts.build:mac:intel: node scripts/prepare.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/licenses.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --ci --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg -- --locked
scripts.build:native:arm64: node scripts/prepare.mjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin && node scripts/licenses.mjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --ci --target aarch64-apple-darwin --features native-e2e --bundles app -- --locked
scripts.build:native:intel: node scripts/prepare.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/licenses.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --ci --target x86_64-apple-darwin --features native-e2e --bundles app -- --locked
